title: Debutant Aniesh Performed Every Action Scene Without a Dupe, Venky Kudumula Says
excerpt: The producer says the newcomer did his own stunts in Itlu Arjuna, the mute-protagonist thriller presented by Nagarjuna and opening November 13.
body:
• Producer Venky Kudumula says debutant Aniesh performed every action sequence in Itlu Arjuna himself, with no dupe used anywhere in the film.
  • The Telugu film, directed by debutant Mahesh Uppala, stars Aniesh as a mute protagonist opposite Anaswara Rajan and is presented by Nagarjuna.
  • Jr NTR unveiled the trailer on November 6, and the film is set to reach theatres on November 13.
  • Venky, making his debut as a producer under What Next Entertainments, says he is already considering directing Aniesh in a future film.

Debutant actor Aniesh performed all of his own action sequences in the forthcoming Telugu film Itlu Arjuna, producer Venky Kudumula has said, with the production using no body double anywhere in the film. Venky made the claim while discussing his first production venture, as reported by Telugu360.

"Aniesh has done an outstanding job in the action sequences. We haven't used a dupe anywhere; he performed all the action himself. I am even considering doing a film with him as a director."

— Venky Kudumula, producer, Itlu Arjuna

A Debut Built Around Silence

Itlu Arjuna marks the acting debut of Aniesh and the directorial debut of Mahesh Uppala. Aniesh plays Arjun, a speech-impaired young man, opposite Anaswara Rajan as the female lead, Keerthi. Venky told Telugu360 that a fresh face suited the role because audiences would meet the character without any preconceived image of the actor, and that Anaswara Rajan was herself drawn to the story. According to Cinema Express, the trailer blends crime, romance and suspense: police tracking a thief draw the mute but sharp Arjun into their investigation, and a mysterious pen drive and a Rs 1,000-crore deal form the crux of the chase that follows.

Venky said Aniesh was already familiar to him before casting, having frequently visited his office and spoken about his interest in films, and that he was impressed by the time the newcomer had invested in training in acting, dancing and action. In a separate interview with Telugu360, Aniesh said his bond with Venky dates back to the director's work on Bheeshma, and that playing a character without dialogue made even dubbing a demanding exercise, because the sounds that accompany expression through body language had to be got exactly right.

Nagarjuna and Jr NTR Lend Their Backing

The film arrives with two of Telugu cinema's biggest names attached. Nagarjuna presents the film. Venky said Nagarjuna was first shown a glimpse of the film and was asked to lend his voice-over only if he liked what he saw; impressed by the cinematography, Nagarjuna chose the same cinematographer, Raja Mahadhevan, for his own film King 100, and has since watched Itlu Arjuna and appreciated the whole team. Jr NTR then unveiled the trailer on November 6. "Your debut speaks without a single word and that takes real guts," he wrote to Aniesh on X, as Cinema Express reported. S. Thaman has composed the music.

The Director Who Drove for Rapido

Venky also used the interviews to tell his director's story. He said he was moved by Mahesh Uppala's determination to make films despite setbacks: Mahesh had previously directed a successful web series, Oka Chinna Family Story, but during a gap before his next opportunity he worked as a Rapido driver. Venky said that having been given a chance himself when he was starting out, he wanted to extend the same support to new talent, and that the freshness of Mahesh's script convinced him this was the right project with which to begin producing.

What Happens Next

Itlu Arjuna is scheduled to open in theatres on November 13. Venky's own next project as a filmmaker will be a comedy entertainer, for which he told Telugu360 he has already completed a promising script. For Aniesh, the test arrives with the release: a first film carried largely without dialogue, in which, on his producer's account, every punch and chase was also his own work.

nri_angle: A Telugu debut built around a mute protagonist, backed by Nagarjuna and Jr NTR, is the kind of word-of-mouth release diaspora audiences track ahead of its November 13 opening.
